## Overview Validate AuxOutput SHM arena coverage before allocation and report conservative host-memory estimates with actionable KV block adjustments. This isolates the memory checks extracted from #49555. ## Claims - Reject an explicit `aux_output_config.max_bytes` that cannot cover all GPU KV blocks. Unset or increase the arena cap to resolve this configuration error. - Warn and continue when estimated host-memory demand exceeds current headroom: cgroup usage can include reclaimable cache. Keep the selected arena capacity; do not automatically shrink it or change GPU KV blocks. - Estimate system/cgroup headroom, all local DP output workers, staging, per-object metadata and runtime reserve, rounded to complete hash objects. No new environment variable or configuration field is added. - Give a smaller KV block suggestion only when it fits the required `max_model_len`; require a matching arena adjustment for explicit `max_bytes`. Do not suggest unchanged or zero block counts. ## Validation - **34 passed** after merging upstream `503e4e16ad`: 22 AuxOutput budget, arena, staging and automatic-memory-detection cases, plus 12 existing public cgroup-reader/preflight cases. On Windows these were run as isolated AST copies of the existing test functions and logging fixture, with unrelated top-level imports omitted. Production modules were imported normally; no replacement vLLM objects were used. This does not establish that the full test_store suite passed. The temporary test files were executed with: ```bash python -m pytest --noconftest -q -p no:cacheprovider test_budget_current.py test_cgroup_existing.py ``` - Before/after regression evidence: the same nine memory-warning cases failed against the saved implementation before the layered-check change, because it raised `ValueError` on insufficient estimated headroom. All nine pass with the update. The baseline command used: ```bash python -m pytest --noconftest -q -p no:cacheprovider test_layered_before.py -k 'host_budget_counts or explicit_arena_budget or staging_exhaustion or host_budget_warns' --tb=line # 9 failed, 13 deselected ``` - These checks passed: ```bash ruff check vllm/envs.py vllm/distributed/aux_output_connector/memory.py vllm/distributed/aux_output_connector/worker.py tests/distributed/aux_output_connector/test_store.py ruff format --check vllm/envs.py vllm/distributed/aux_output_connector/memory.py vllm/distributed/aux_output_connector/worker.py tests/distributed/aux_output_connector/test_store.py mypy --follow-imports=skip --ignore-missing-imports vllm/distributed/aux_output_connector/memory.py vllm/distributed/aux_output_connector/worker.py python tools/pre_commit/check_test_tethering.py tests/distributed/aux_output_connector/test_store.py git diff --check ``` Capacity, hash rounding, staging, DP, metadata, reserve and total host-demand assignment formulas were also checked to be AST-identical to the original PR implementation. - The standard command cannot collect on this Windows host because `tests/conftest.py` imports unavailable `uvloop` through vLLM: ```bash python -m pytest -q tests/distributed/aux_output_connector/test_store.py -k 'budget or arena_limit or staging_exhaustion or host_memory' ``` - Full pre-commit was attempted on the four modified files. Its hook environments could not initialize: the default cache was read-only, and retrying with a project-local cache failed in Git for Windows with `NtCreateDirectoryObject ... 0xC0000022`. The checks above ran separately. The two new commits used a command-local hooks override; repository hook configuration was not changed. Both commits have Signed-off-by trailers. - No full test_store, Linux model-startup/E2E, model evaluation, GPU/H20 or performance validation is claimed. No model math or inference-output changes are intended. **Draft pending Linux/startup validation and human review.** ## Details For N GPU KV blocks, B tokens per block and payload width R, the default arena is N * B * R bytes per output worker. Host demand includes the arena, estimated 512-byte metadata per hash object, existing staged blocks and in-flight CPU snapshots, plus max(512 MiB, 5% of current headroom) runtime reserve. System available RAM is capped by valid cgroup limit minus current usage. Unavailable or invalid cgroup readings fall back to system available RAM. This subtraction is conservative because usage includes reclaimable cache; insufficient estimated headroom therefore produces a warning rather than a startup rejection. Logs describe a conservative capacity estimate, not an absolute supported maximum or proof that the configuration is impossible. An explicit arena is independent of KV block count. Reducing blocks alone cannot shrink it, so the warning prioritizes unsetting/resizing that cap and explicitly couples it with a block adjustment when needed. Block advice must accommodate `max_model_len`; staging exhaustion receives a separate diagnostic. The Store uses anonymous shared mmap storage, so /dev/shm filesystem free space does not define its capacity. These checks are startup estimates, not atomic reservations or runtime memory limits: allocation can still fail and concurrent allocations or later SHM growth can still cause OOM. This PR integrates with the existing R3 output worker. It does not change Store storage/LRU/growth, the SHM protocol, Capture/Replay, Indexer model adapters, or GPU KV initialization/profiling. When combined with #49555, the caller must account for the combined artifact width and temporary packed Indexer staging. Duplicate-work checks were refreshed for #47280 and open AuxOutput/host-memory PRs. This updates the existing extracted PR, rather than opening a competing implementation. #49555 and #62915 cover Indexer capture/replay; #57968 adds a Mooncake backend. The host-memory diagnostics remain isolated here. AI assistance was used. The human submitter remains responsible for reviewing every changed line and completing relevant validation before requesting review. ---

(Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

 ### How it works: aux output connector
 
-Routing is stored by the aux output connector (`vllm/distributed/aux_output_connector/`, configured via `--aux-output-config`), keyed by KV block hash and shared with prefix caching, which is why prefix caching is required. `max_bytes` is its host-memory LRU capacity (default: derived from KV cache capacity). If a prefix-cache hit needs evicted rows, the worker raises `BlockObjectStoreError`; increase `max_bytes`.
+Routing is stored by the aux output connector (`vllm/distributed/aux_output_connector/`, configured via `--aux-output-config`), keyed by KV block hash and shared with prefix caching, which is why prefix caching is required. `max_bytes` is its initial SHM arena capacity (default: derived from KV cache capacity). An explicit value must cover the startup KV coverage described below. It is not a hard runtime memory cap: the arena grows when every object is referenced, and cached objects are evicted by LRU. If a prefix-cache hit needs evicted rows, the worker raises `BlockObjectStoreError`; increase `max_bytes`.
+
+## Host-memory admission
+
+For `N` GPU KV blocks, `B` tokens/block and `R` routed-expert bytes/token, the
+default SHM arena needs `N * B * R` bytes per output worker. When
+`aux_output_config.max_bytes` is set, it must cover every KV block; an
+undersized arena is rejected instead of silently reducing replay coverage.
+
+Before creating the Store, startup queries system available RAM and the remaining
+container cgroup memory, using the smaller value. The Store uses anonymous shared
+`mmap`, so `/dev/shm` mount free space is not its capacity limit; see the
+[Linux tmpfs documentation](https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/filesystems/tmpfs.html).
+If the cgroup limit or usage is unavailable or invalid, startup uses system
+available RAM. Cgroup headroom is conservatively estimated as limit minus current
+usage, including reclaimable page cache. Low estimated headroom produces a warning
+and startup continues, since cache reclamation may allow the allocation to fit.
+The check reserves runtime headroom, accounts for staging and estimated metadata,
+and divides the remaining budget across local DP output workers. This assumes
+local DP workers share one host/cgroup memory budget; workers isolated in
+separate containers may use less, so the estimate can be conservative. It then
+rounds down to complete SHM objects and estimates a GPU KV block count that fits
+the current headroom.
+
+An explicit `aux_output_config.max_bytes` that cannot cover all KV blocks is a
+configuration error and prevents startup. Unset it to derive capacity from KV
+coverage, or increase it to the required size. An explicit value is still the
+initial arena capacity and may grow at runtime; it is not a hard memory cap.
+
+If the estimated arena, staging, metadata and reserve exceed current headroom,
+startup logs a warning with memory estimates and optional adjustments. For an
+explicit `max_bytes`, the warning first suggests unsetting or resizing it;
+reducing KV blocks alone does not shrink an explicit arena. If fewer KV blocks
+are also needed to fit the estimate, both changes are suggested together. With
+automatic sizing, the reported `--num-gpu-blocks-override N` (Python:
+`num_gpu_blocks_override=N`) is only printed when the estimate can serve at
+least one `max_model_len` request under the model's KV cache layout, including
+reserved capacity such as the BlockPool null block. It is never zero, negative,
+or the current block count. Otherwise, the warning suggests more memory, less
+staging, or a smaller `--max-model-len` instead of an infeasible block count.
+These estimates do not establish that a configuration is impossible to run.
+
+Alternatively, reduce `--kv-cache-memory-bytes` or `--gpu-memory-utilization`.
+An explicit KV memory byte budget takes precedence over utilization; no linear
+conversion from CPU RAM to a GPU utilization percentage is assumed. If staging
+and runtime reserve exhaust the estimated headroom, the warning suggests more
+RAM/container memory or smaller `--max-num-batched-tokens`/`--max-num-seqs`
+instead of zero blocks.
+
+These estimates cover the preallocated arena, staging, estimated metadata and
+runtime reserve. They do not bound runtime memory: `publish_routed_experts()`
+serializes each published payload, the background store may queue pending
+batches, the arena grows when every object is referenced and briefly holds both
+the old and new arena, and concurrent worker startup or other processes add
+more. This is a startup estimate, not an atomic host-memory reservation or a
+runtime limit. Startup continues after memory warnings and can still fail
+during actual allocation or encounter OOM as concurrent allocations and output
+accumulation change memory usage.
 
 ## Output format

+def budget_logs(caplog):
+    from vllm.distributed.aux_output_connector.memory import logger

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("available_host_bytes", [0, 2 << 30])
+def test_budget_covers_every_kv_block_without_silent_truncation(
+    available_host_bytes, budget_logs
+):
+    assert (
+        validate_shm_budget(
+            num_blocks=10,
+            scheduler_block_size=16,
+            hash_block_size=16,
+            bytes_per_token=20,
+            max_bytes=None,
+            available_host_bytes=2 << 30,
+            staging_bytes=0,
+            min_blocks_for_context=11,
+        )
+        == 3200
+    )
+    assert not any(record.levelname == "WARNING" for record in budget_logs.records)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="cannot cover all GPU KV blocks") as error:
+        validate_shm_budget(
+            num_blocks=10,
+            scheduler_block_size=16,
+            bytes_per_token=20,
+            max_bytes=3199,
+            hash_block_size=16,
+            available_host_bytes=available_host_bytes,
+            staging_bytes=0,
+            min_blocks_for_context=11,
+            required_context_tokens=160,
+        )
+    message = str(error.value)
+    assert "Unset aux_output_config.max_bytes" in message
+    assert "increase it to at least 3200 bytes" in message
+    assert "--num-gpu-blocks-override" not in message
+    assert "No feasible AuxOutput configuration" not in message
+
+
+def test_host_budget_counts_local_workers_and_hash_object_metadata(budget_logs):
+    """The inferred KV limit includes every local arena and all hash slots."""
+    validate_budget = partial(

+        scheduler_block_size=16,
+        hash_block_size=4,
+        bytes_per_token=20,
+        max_bytes=None,
+        available_host_bytes=(512 << 20) + 22400,
+        staging_bytes=4096,
+        min_blocks_for_context=3,
+        local_output_workers=2,
+        required_context_tokens=32,
+    )
+    assert validate_budget(num_blocks=2) == 640
+    assert not any(record.levelname == "WARNING" for record in budget_logs.records)
+    budget_logs.clear()
+    assert validate_budget(num_blocks=4) == 1280
+    message = budget_logs.text
+    assert any(record.levelname == "WARNING" for record in budget_logs.records)
+    assert "conservative KV block estimate=3" in message
+    assert "--num-gpu-blocks-override 3" in message
+    assert "Startup will continue" in message
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_blocks", [2, 4])
+def test_explicit_arena_budget_warns_with_actionable_adjustments(
+    num_blocks, budget_logs
+):
+    """Fewer KV blocks alone do not shrink an explicit arena allocation."""
+    validate_budget = partial(
+        validate_shm_budget,
+        scheduler_block_size=16,
+        hash_block_size=16,
+        bytes_per_token=20,
+        available_host_bytes=(512 << 20) + 4096 + 3 * (320 + 512),
+        staging_bytes=4096,
+        min_blocks_for_context=3,
+        required_context_tokens=32,
+    )
+    assert validate_budget(num_blocks=num_blocks, max_bytes=4 * 320) == 4 * 320
+    message = budget_logs.text
+    assert any(record.levelname == "WARNING" for record in budget_logs.records)
+    assert "Unset aux_output_config.max_bytes" in message
+    if num_blocks == 2:
+        assert "--num-gpu-blocks-override" not in message
+    else:

+            "Along with that arena adjustment, consider --num-gpu-blocks-override 3"

+        )
+    assert "conservative KV block estimate=3" in message
+    chosen_blocks = min(num_blocks, 3)
+    assert (
+        validate_budget(num_blocks=chosen_blocks, max_bytes=None) == chosen_blocks * 320

+def test_arena_budget_matches_complete_store_slots():

+            hash_block_size=16,

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("required_context_tokens", [None, 16])

+    assert (
+        validate_shm_budget(
+            num_blocks=1,
+            scheduler_block_size=16,
+            hash_block_size=16,
+            bytes_per_token=20,
+            max_bytes=None,
+            available_host_bytes=available_host_bytes,

+    assert any(record.levelname == "WARNING" for record in budget_logs.records)
+    assert "Staging and runtime reserve exhaust the estimated headroom" in message
+    assert "--max-num-batched-tokens/--max-num-seqs" in message

+    assert "--num-gpu-blocks-override" not in message

+    assert (

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Capacity validation and host-memory estimates for AuxOutput SHM arenas."""
+
+import psutil
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.utils.cpu_resource_utils import (
+    get_cgroup_memory_limit,
+    get_cgroup_memory_usage,
+)
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+_METADATA_BYTES_PER_OBJECT = 512
+
+
+def get_available_host_memory() -> int:
+    """Return current headroom for anonymous shared mappings.
+
+    Cgroup limit minus usage is conservative: usage includes reclaimable page
+    cache, which this startup estimate does not assume will be reclaimed.
+    """
+    available: int = psutil.virtual_memory().available
+    limit = get_cgroup_memory_limit()
+    usage = get_cgroup_memory_usage()
+    if limit is not None and limit >= 0 and usage is not None and usage >= 0:
+        available = min(available, max(0, limit - usage))
+    return available
+
+
+def validate_shm_budget(
+    *,
+    num_blocks: int,
+    scheduler_block_size: int,
+    hash_block_size: int,
+    bytes_per_token: int,
+    max_bytes: int | None,
+    available_host_bytes: int,
+    staging_bytes: int,
+    min_blocks_for_context: int,
+    local_output_workers: int = 1,
+    required_context_tokens: int | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    """Validate KV coverage, warn about host memory and return bytes per worker.
+
+    The host-memory estimate covers the preallocated arena, staging, metadata
+    and runtime reserve at startup. It excludes serialized routing payloads,
+    background-store queued batches, the transient old-plus-new arena while the
+    store grows, and concurrent memory use, so it is not a runtime peak bound.
+
+    Args:
+        num_blocks: GPU KV blocks per worker.
+        scheduler_block_size: Tokens covered by each GPU KV block.
+        hash_block_size: Tokens stored in one SHM object.
+        bytes_per_token: Sum of all enabled artifact payload widths.
+        max_bytes: Configured arena capacity, or None to match KV coverage.
+        available_host_bytes: Current system/cgroup memory headroom.
+        staging_bytes: Estimated staging memory per output worker.
+        min_blocks_for_context: Minimum device KV pool blocks that can serve one
+            request at max_model_len, including the BlockPool null block.
+            Smaller block counts must not be suggested as an override.
+        local_output_workers: Output workers assumed to share this host-memory
+            budget. Workers isolated in separate containers make the estimate
+            conservative.
+        required_context_tokens: Tokens one request must be able to serve, used
+            in the warning text.
+
+    Returns:
+        Arena capacity rounded down to complete SHM objects.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: The configured arena cannot cover all GPU KV blocks.
+
+    """
+    object_bytes = hash_block_size * bytes_per_token
+    hashes_per_block = scheduler_block_size // hash_block_size
+    required_bytes = num_blocks * scheduler_block_size * bytes_per_token
+    arena_bytes = required_bytes if max_bytes is None else max_bytes
+    num_objects = arena_bytes // object_bytes
+    arena_bytes = num_objects * object_bytes
+    gib = 1024**3
+    if required_bytes > arena_bytes:
+        coverage = (
+            "cannot hold one KV block"
+            if num_objects < hashes_per_block
+            else "cannot cover all GPU KV blocks"
+        )
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"AuxOutput SHM arena {coverage}: required SHM="
+            f"{required_bytes / gib:.3f} GiB per worker; arena capacity="
+            f"{arena_bytes / gib:.3f} GiB per worker; KV blocks={num_blocks}. "
+            "Unset aux_output_config.max_bytes to size the arena from KV "
+            f"coverage, or increase it to at least {required_bytes} bytes."
+        )
+    metadata_bytes = num_objects * _METADATA_BYTES_PER_OBJECT
+    reserve_bytes = max(512 << 20, available_host_bytes // 20)
+    worker_headroom = max(
+        0,
+        (available_host_bytes - reserve_bytes) // local_output_workers - staging_bytes,
+    )
+    host_objects = worker_headroom // (object_bytes + _METADATA_BYTES_PER_OBJECT)
+    max_host_shm_bytes = host_objects * object_bytes
+    supported_blocks = host_objects // hashes_per_block
+    recommended_blocks = (
+        supported_blocks
+        if min_blocks_for_context <= supported_blocks < num_blocks
+        else None
+    )
+    estimated_startup_need = (
+        local_output_workers * (arena_bytes + staging_bytes + metadata_bytes)
+        + reserve_bytes
+    )
+    adjustment = ""
+    if estimated_startup_need > available_host_bytes:
+        adjustment = (
+            " Estimated startup host-memory need exceeds current headroom. "
+            "Startup will continue, but AuxOutput may run out of host memory. "
+            "This is a conservative startup estimate, not a runtime peak bound; "
+            "cgroup usage may include reclaimable page cache. "
+        )
+        if max_bytes is not None:
+            adjustment += (
+                "Unset aux_output_config.max_bytes to size the arena from the "
+                "chosen KV block count, or resize it to cover that count within "
+                "the estimated headroom. "
+            )
+        max_context_tokens = supported_blocks * scheduler_block_size
+        if available_host_bytes <= reserve_bytes + local_output_workers * staging_bytes:
+            adjustment += (
+                "Staging and runtime reserve exhaust the estimated headroom. "
+                "Increase available RAM/container memory or reduce "
+                "--max-num-batched-tokens/--max-num-seqs to reduce staging memory."
+            )
+        elif supported_blocks == 0:
+            adjustment += (
+                "The estimated headroom cannot fit one GPU KV block. Increase "
+                "available RAM/container memory or reduce staging memory."
+            )
+        elif supported_blocks < min_blocks_for_context:
+            if required_context_tokens is not None:
+                needed = (
+                    f"the {min_blocks_for_context} blocks needed to serve "
+                    f"max_model_len={required_context_tokens}"
+                )
+            else:
+                needed = (
+                    f"the {min_blocks_for_context} blocks needed for one "
+                    "max_model_len request"
+                )
+            adjustment += (
+                f"The conservative estimate supports {supported_blocks} KV blocks "
+                f"({max_context_tokens} tokens), fewer than {needed}. Increase "
+                "available RAM/container memory, reduce --max-model-len, or lower "
+                "--max-num-batched-tokens/--max-num-seqs to reduce staging memory."
+            )
+        elif recommended_blocks is not None:
+            if max_bytes is not None:
+                adjustment += "Along with that arena adjustment, consider "
+            else:
+                adjustment += "Consider "
+            adjustment += (
+                f"--num-gpu-blocks-override {recommended_blocks} "
+                f"(Python: num_gpu_blocks_override={recommended_blocks}) to fit "
+                "the conservative estimate. Keep enough KV capacity for "
+                "--max-model-len if reducing further. Alternatively, lower "
+                "--kv-cache-memory-bytes or --gpu-memory-utilization; an explicit "
+                "--kv-cache-memory-bytes overrides --gpu-memory-utilization."
+            )
+    log_fn = (
+        logger.warning if estimated_startup_need > available_host_bytes else logger.info
+    )
+    log_fn(
+        "AuxOutput memory budget (startup estimate): "
+        "available system/cgroup=%.3f GiB, "
+        "runtime reserve=%.3f GiB, local output workers=%d; "
+        "per worker: required SHM=%.3f GiB, allocated SHM=%.3f GiB, "
+        "estimated SHM headroom=%.3f GiB, staging=%.3f GiB, "
+        "metadata estimate=%.3f GiB; total required SHM=%.3f GiB, "
+        "estimated startup need=%.3f GiB; KV blocks=%d, "
+        "conservative KV block estimate=%d.%s",
+        available_host_bytes / gib,
+        reserve_bytes / gib,
+        local_output_workers,
+        required_bytes / gib,
+        arena_bytes / gib,
+        max_host_shm_bytes / gib,
+        staging_bytes / gib,
+        metadata_bytes / gib,
+        local_output_workers * required_bytes / gib,
+        estimated_startup_need / gib,
+        num_blocks,
+        supported_blocks,
+        adjustment,
+    )
+    return arena_bytes
